purpose: Use the paid FinMind all-market feed inside the existing governed HENGCE EOD vessel to monitor Taiwan equities across TWSE, TPEx and emerging markets. Electronics100 remains diagnostic only and is no longer the primary Market State observation scope.

data_vessel.membership_rule: take latest date row per stock_id; monitor current twse/tpex/emerging four-digit equities; exclude ETF/ETN/warrant-like non-equities by membership/category/code filters

scope_semantics.all_taiwan_equities: combined breadth/context across current TWSE, TPEx and emerging equities
scope_semantics.emerging_equities: current emerging-board equities; kept separately because trading/volume microstructure differs
scope_semantics.hengce_electronics100_diagnostic: legacy operating-universe diagnostic only; not the primary market monitor

allowed_persisted_derived_context: membership report date and market counts
cross-sectional change-rate mean/median/quantiles in vendor units
cross-sectional median absolute change rate in vendor units
aggregate turnover and top-10 turnover share
explicitly_not_authorized: persisting raw or per-ticker FinMind snapshot rows in this Market State auxiliary
using Electronics100 as the primary whole-market observation scope
changing frozen S5 Market State features
creating or selecting a new state label
